text: What are you to today as a nutritionist? For breakfast I made my favourite get the glow avocado toast. I mixed my avocado with lots of basil, spring onion, a crumbly feta and a scattering of prepared pomegranate seeds. A little sprinkle gives my dishes a boost of fibre, glow giving vitamin C, B vitamins and a huge hit of antioxidants. You will always find a pot of prepared pomegranate seeds in my fridge to give their extra nutrition boost to all my dishes. For lunch I made my K.L.C.'s a salad with crispy crouton garlic chick-thes. I use yogurt in my signature dressing which gives a gorgeous creamy tang and helps soften the kale. Dinner was my chicken ramesco bowl with roasted hazelnuts, roasted peppers, smoked paprika, a little bit of vinegar, garlic and olive oil. It creates the most gorgeous smoky sauce that pairs so well with the sweet pop of pomegranate seeds. This is your science go and grab a pack of prepared pomegranate seeds for a healthy and easy way to elevate your dishes. I honestly just scatter them on everything. I wound down with a golden milk tea and a warm mince pie. [BLANK_AUDIO]
